subject: general
question: P can run 300 m in 20 s and Q can run the same distance in 30 s. By what distance is P ahead of Q after 4 s, if both start the race at the same time?
solution:
**Given:**

P can run 300 m in 20 s

Q can run 300 m in 30 s

Both start the race at the same time

Time elapsed = 4 s

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Speed of P = 300 m / 20 s</p&g
